purpose: Reusable citizen-facing answer structure for verified Ireland Housing Data pathways.

sections.label: THE ANSWER
sections.rule: State only the result supported by the current legal composition.

sections.label: LEGAL BASIS
sections.rule: Identify the canonical proposition and applicable legal regime.

sections.label: SOURCES
sections.rule: Separate primary law, court authority, official guidance and tools.

sections.label: WHAT IS VERIFIED
sections.rule: Show verified facts/evidence and unresolved evidence.

sections.label: CONDITIONS
sections.rule: Show material statutory or procedural conditions.

sections.label: DEADLINE
sections.rule: Show only a deadline whose trigger and legal rule are established.

sections.label: WHAT TO DO NEXT
sections.rule: Provide the applicable official route or identify what must be resolved first.

sections.label: LAST VERIFIED
sections.rule: Display the verification date for the current proposition/package.

result_policy.YES: Only where the legal composition supports an affirmative proposition.
result_policy.NO: Only where the applicable legal rule and facts establish the negative result.
result_policy.POSSIBLY: Use where material facts/evidence remain unresolved.
result_policy.NOT_DETERMINABLE: Use where the current verified dataset cannot resolve the issue.
result_policy.HISTORICAL: Use when historical legal research controls.
result_policy.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Use for conflicting evidence or unresolved material legal issues.

global_rules: Never present CICAN explanation as statutory text.
Never treat an official link as proof of entitlement.
Every legal proposition must resolve to evidence.
Every displayed answer must retain its legal/time scope.
